generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Rust (stable, 2021) command-line G-code simulator under `output/` with an empty `[dependencies]` section.

- Cargo project: `output/Cargo.toml`, entrypoint `output/src/main.rs`
- Builds/runs as required: `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml` and `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- <args>`
- CLI flags implemented: `--input`, `--output`, plus optional `--tool-table`, `--parameter-input`, `--parameter-output`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`, `--probe-box`, `--probe-tool`, `--trace-output` with exactly one of `--trace-time-step|--trace-distance-step|--trace-position-tolerance`
- Writes result JSON to `--output` on both success/error; writes trace JSON to `--trace-output` on both success/error; writes `--parameter-output` only on success.

Key files:
- `output/src/sim.rs`: parser/evaluator + execution engine + JSON output/trace writing
- `output/src/parse.rs`: block/word parsing (comments, `;`, `(...)`, block-delete `/`)
- `output/src/toolfile.rs`: RS274 tool table loader (basic `T/P/D/Z` fields)
- `output/src/varfile.rs`: RS274 parameter file load/write
- `output/src/json.rs`: dependency-free JSON serializer

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
